command.name: Blazing Fury
verbatim: Each Round: 20% chance to increase Fire Damage Dealt by +10% and First-Strike to 1 Ally in any lane, prioritizing Fire Damage allies, for 2 round(s).
Rounds 1, 4, 6, 9: Deal Tactical Damage to 1 Enemy within adjacency (Damage Rate: +110%).

At 6+ Stars: Rounds 2, 5, 8: Recover the Ally with the fewest troops (Recovery Rate: +60%, enhanced by Initiative); increased to +90% if any Enemy is afflicted with Slow. 30% chance to grant Resistance (-20%) for 2 round(s).

vanguard.name: Sentinel's Wit
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard, increase your Tactical Damage Dealt by +16%. Increase Instinct and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

habits.name: Mindful Synergy
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase the Intelligence and Instinct (enhanced by Initiative) of 3 Allies in any lane by +7.8% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Flight Mastery
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase Initiative by +7.2% (enhanced by Instinct) of 3 Allies in any lane and reduce Initiative by -7% (enhanced by Instinct) of 3 Enemies in any lane until the end of combat.

habits.name: Strategic Revival
habits.verbatim: Blazing Fury gains: Rounds 2, 5, 8: Apply Recovery to the Ally with the least troops (Recovery Rate: +60%, enhanced by Initiative). The amount of Recovery is increased by 1.5x (+90%) if an Enemy is afflicted with Slow. Additionally, there is a 30% chance to grant the target Resistance (-20%) for 2 round(s).

habits.name: Tactical Inferno
habits.verbatim: Start of Round 1: Increase the Tactical Damage Dealt of 1 Ally in any lane (prioritizes the Left Flank) and the Fire Damage Dealt of 1 Ally in any lane (prioritizes the Right Flank) by +18% for 3 round(s).

habits.name: Mother's Mercy
habits.verbatim: Each Round: 14% chance to Cleanse 2 Negative and 1 Control effects from 1 Ally in any lane (prioritizes allies afflicted with a Control effect).
